name: Ward Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves a small ward of sealed qi on the point struck.

name: Ward Brace
description: Brace the arms behind a ward of sealed qi so a heavy cut is stopped without a tremor.

name: Ward Slide
description: Slide through the foe's reach with a ward laid behind each foot so no counter can follow.

name: Lock Turn
description: Turn the wrist over a striking arm and lock it with qi for a beat as it passes.

name: Warding Hand
description: Lay a warding hand on the foe's shoulder and damp the qi in his whole arm to a trickle.

name: Lock Catch
description: Catch the foe's guard on a hooked finger and drive the sealed qi through the gap it opens.

name: Ward Mend
description: Lay a ward of sealed qi across a torn muscle to hold it closed while it mends in yourself or an ally.

name: Warded Lock
description: Fix a ward-lock on the foe's core channel so no technique above the plain blows can begin until it breaks.

name: Ward Burst
description: Loose every stored ward at once in a ring of force that throws back all foes close about you.

name: Limb Palm
description: Slap the outer arm with a sealed palm so the limb tingles and drops from the line.

name: Limb Guard
description: Seal the qi in one forearm and take a heavy blow on it as on a block of iron.

name: Limb Step
description: Plant the sealed rear leg and swing the lead leg through a long arc to a new stance.

name: Limb Turn
description: Rotate the sealed forearm against a blade's flat and send it off to the outside.

name: Limb Reading
description: Feel the qi in each of the foe's limbs and learn which is weaker and which is about to move.

name: Arm Seal
description: Cut the qi to the foe's striking arm at the shoulder so it hangs without strength.

name: Leg Seal
description: Cut the qi to the foe's lead leg at the hip so the step falters and the stance drops.

name: Curse Drain
description: Seal a cursed limb off from the body and force the curse out through the fingertips of yourself or an ally.

name: Limb Interdict
description: Seal a whole limb of the foe from the rest of his qi so it hangs dead for many breaths.

name: Hinge Break
description: Lodge sealed qi in a joint and burst it outward so the hinge of the elbow or knee fails.

name: Closure Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a flat sheet of sealed qi from the whole field into the blow.

name: Closure Guard
description: Close the qi field tight round the body so a blow meets a smooth and unbroken surface.

name: Closure Step
description: Carry the closed field along with each stride so the body moves as one sealed shell.

name: Closure Turn
description: Let a blow slide along the closed edge of the field and spin away past the shoulder.

name: Closure Draw
description: Draw the qi into the sealed field and hold it dense there so the next techniques cost less.

name: Closure Reading
description: Press the closed field outward like a feeler and read the shape and strength of any qi it touches.

name: Shut Palm
description: Close a hand over the foe's chest and shut the outer layer of his field so techniques come slow.

name: Seal Pierce
description: Thrust a finger sheathed in sealed qi through the guard and into a channel beneath it.

name: Fielded Mend
description: Close the field round a wounded ally and let the sealed qi hold the wound shut while it knits.

name: Closure Cleanse
description: Seal the field round a tainted wound and press the taint out through the skin of yourself or an ally.

name: Locked Draw
description: Close the foe's own qi field so he can neither draw qi in nor push it out for many breaths.

name: Closure Lock
description: Lay a closed field of sealed qi on the ground that holds any foe who steps into it.

name: Sigil Palm
description: Strike with a palm that draws a small sigil of sealed qi on the point of contact.

name: Sigil Guard
description: Trace a sigil in the air before the chest and let a blow break against its lines.

name: Sigil Step
description: Step along the strokes of a sigil laid on the ground and finish at the point it ends.

name: Sigil Turn
description: Draw one stroke of a sigil across a strike so it is turned and spends itself.

name: Sigil Press
description: Press a sigil into the foe's forearm that stops the qi from rising to the hand.

name: Sigil Pierce
description: Drive the last stroke of a sigil as a spear of sealed qi straight through the guard.

name: Sigil Brand
description: Brand a sigil onto the foe's chest that holds one named technique shut until the mark fades.

name: Sigil Burst
description: Break a drawn sigil outward in a burst of sealed qi that flings back all near foes.

name: Interdict Palm
description: Strike the foe's breastbone with a palm that carries a prohibition of sealed qi into the chest.

name: Interdict Guard
description: Hold a prohibition of sealed qi before the body so a blow is refused at the surface.

name: Interdict Step
description: Move forward with a forbidding hand held out so the foe hesitates before each counter.

name: Interdict Turn
description: Refuse a thrust with a flat hand and push it out of line before it can land.

name: Interdict Reading
description: Feel the foe's qi for the technique it is gathering and name it before it is loosed.

name: Hushing Interdict
description: Lay a hushing prohibition on the foe's qi so the technique he was gathering fades half formed.

name: Interdict Shell
description: Wrap yourself and a near ally in a shell of prohibition that refuses weak blows outright.

name: Cleansing Interdict
description: Forbid a taint further passage through the body and force it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Technique Interdict
description: Forbid one technique to the foe so he cannot call it again for the length of the fight.

name: Broad Interdict
description: Spread a prohibition over the ground about you that slows the techniques of every foe within it.

name: Tumbler Palm
description: Strike with a palm that turns a tumbler of qi inside the foe and sets his stance.

name: Tumbler Guard
description: Set the tumblers of the guard so a blow finds no key to open it.

name: Tumbler Step
description: Click the stance from one set position to the next in short exact steps.

name: Tumbler Turn
description: Turn a blow through a quarter circle on the wrist as a key turns in a lock.

name: Tumbler Draw
description: Set the tumblers of the body one by one until the qi flows through the limbs without waste.

name: Tumbler Reading
description: Feel the qi round a locked place or a locked body and read how its tumblers are set.

name: Tumbler Seal
description: Turn a tumbler in the foe's main channel so the qi stops at that place and goes no further.

name: Tumbler Pierce
description: Slide a thin pick of qi into the guard and turn it so the whole defense gives way.

name: Key Mend
description: Turn a small key of qi in a wound and lock the torn flesh together in yourself or an ally.

name: Master Lock
description: Set a master lock on the foe's qi so that nothing but a breaking blow will undo it.

name: Breath Key
description: Turn a key of sealed qi in the chest of an ally whose breath has just stopped to lock the last life in and restart it.

name: Latchsworn Palm
description: Strike with a palm that swears the blow home and leaves a small seal where it lands.

name: Latchsworn Guard
description: Hold the guard under a sworn seal that does not break as long as the stance is kept.

name: Latchsworn Step
description: Take each step as a sworn mark and land exactly on it without drift or slip.

name: Latchsworn Turn
description: Turn a blow from the sworn line and leave it no second chance to enter.

name: Oath Latch
description: Latch the foe's wrist to his own belt with a sworn seal that holds until he strikes out.

name: Sworn Latch
description: Swear a seal onto the foe's chest channel that weakens his strongest technique for a short span.

name: Latchsworn Mend
description: Swear the wound shut with a seal that stays until the oath is spent in yourself or an ally.

name: Latchsworn Lock
description: Set a seal that holds exactly as long as the user keeps the oath that set it.

name: Sworn Barrier
description: Stand a sworn barrier of sealed qi before you and the allies at your back that no blow below its tier can cross.

name: Lulled Palm
description: Strike with an unhurried palm that lays a hush of sealed qi over the part struck.

name: Lulled Guard
description: Hold the guard in perfect stillness so the force of a blow dies in the sealed air before it.

name: Lulled Step
description: Move in a smooth unhurried step that stirs nothing and leaves no trace of intent.

name: Lulled Turn
description: Meet a blow with a still palm and let it slide round the edge of the hush.

name: Lulled Reading
description: Still the qi about you completely and feel every ripple that a foe sends through it.

name: Calming Seal
description: Lay a calming seal on the foe's heart-qi so his rage drains and his strikes lose their edge.

name: Windless Hold
description: Still the air within a short reach so no wind-borne technique can cross it.

name: Lulled Mend
description: Hush the pain of a wound under a sealed calm and close its edges for yourself or an ally.

name: Deadening Calm
description: Drop a dead calm over the ground about you so every foe in it finds his qi sluggish and his limbs heavy.

name: Torpor Seal
description: Seal one foe into a deep lull in which no technique can be started and no guard raised.

name: Mute Palm
description: Strike with a palm that makes no sound and leaves a seal of quiet on the chest.

name: Mute Guard
description: Take a blow into sealed qi that gives back neither sound nor shock to the foe.

name: Mute Tread
description: Step on a sealed sole that makes no sound whatever the ground is.

name: Mute Turn
description: Turn a strike off the forearm with no clash and no noise to warn the others near.

name: Mute Draw
description: Draw the qi into stillness and let it gather unseen for the next burst of power.

name: Mute Reading
description: Hold the field in stillness and mark each foe by the small disturbance he makes in it.

name: Mute Seal
description: Seal the foe's throat and breath so he can neither shout a signal nor call a technique aloud.

name: Mute Press
description: Press the foe's qi into silence so his strike goes forth with no force behind it.

name: Mute Mend
description: Hush the wound and the pain together under a quiet seal for yourself or an ally.

name: Mute Cleanse
description: Quiet a spreading taint under a sealed hush and draw it from the blood of yourself or an ally.

name: Voiceless Seal
description: Seal the foe's voice and his techniques together so he is struck dumb and cannot cast.

name: Silencing Pulse
description: Send a pulse of silence outward that stills the qi of all foes near and dulls their techniques.
